description: List where and how a game TOKEN can be launched from the publisher's own wallet: each network (EVM chains of the new Uniswap-V4 stack and Solana clusters) with its native coin, creation fee, the most a first buy may be, the creator tax rates you can pick, pair currencies (EVM) or pool fee tiers (Solana), and whether holder staking is available. Read-only. Call it before prepare_token_launch. Needs the 'token:launch' permission.
name: get_launch_options
title: List token launch options
